Draw a grid of dots

Source: R/dot_grid.R
dot_grid_plot.Rd

Draw a grid of dots

Usage

dot_grid_plot(
  df,
  x.labels,
  y.labels,
  x.italic = FALSE,
  y.italic = FALSE,
  size.limits,
  size.breaks,
  size.labels = waiver(),
  size.title,
  fill.colours,
  fill.limits,
  fill.center = NULL,
  fill.title,
  na.value = "grey85",
  outline.labels = NULL,
  outline.title = NULL,
  strip.axis = NULL,
  strip.style = "strip",
  cell.width = 0.18,
  cell.height = 0.18,
  x.group.side = "opposite",
  y.group.side = "opposite",
  x.group.cols = NULL,
  y.group.cols = NULL,
  bar.width = 3.5,
  legend.position = "right",
  bg = "transparent"
)

Arguments

df

One row per dot, with columns `x` and `y` (factors; their levels give the order of the columns from left to right and of the rows from top to bottom, and must be unique across groups), `size` (NA: no dot, but the row and column are kept), `fill`, and optionally `x_group` / `y_group` (factors: column / row groups), `outline` (logical: significant dots, drawn opaque with a dark ring; the others are faded) and `strip` (the colour of the row or column, for the group markers)

x.labels, y.labels

Display labels named by level of `x` / `y`

x.italic, y.italic

Whether each label is set in italics (genes): logical vectors named by level, or a single value

size.limits

Range of `size` mapped to dot areas; values beyond are drawn at the nearest end

size.breaks, size.labels

Breaks and labels of the size legend

size.title

Title of the size legend

fill.colours

Colours of the fill scale, from low to high

fill.limits

Limits of the fill scale; values beyond get the colour of the nearest end. For a diverging scale they need not be symmetric (see diverging_limits())

fill.center

Centre of a diverging fill scale, or NULL for a sequential one

fill.title

Title of the fill legend

na.value

Fill of dots whose `fill` is NA

outline.labels

Legend labels of significant and other dots, when `df$outline` is given

outline.title

Title of the significance legend

strip.axis

"x" when the group markers run along the columns (one per column, below the grid), "y" when they run along the rows (one per row, left of the grid), or NULL for none

strip.style

"strip" (a narrow band of tiles) or "dot" (one coloured dot per row or column)

cell.width, cell.height

Size of one column / row in inches

x.group.side, y.group.side

Side of the column / row groups: "opposite" (default; opposite the tick labels: top / right) or "labels" (beyond the labels: bottom / left)

x.group.cols, y.group.cols

Colours of the group bars, named by group; NULL for black

bar.width

Thickness of the group bars in points

legend.position

Position of the legends

bg

Background colour

Value

A ggplot object
